title: Add Okuma GENOS M560-V and M660-V CAT40 machine files

body:
Add clean-room machine definition files for the Okuma GENOS M560-V and GENOS M660-V vertical machining centers in their standard CAT40 BIG-PLUS configurations. Use only Okuma public brochures and specification sheets. Follow `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md`.

## Machine data
- **JSON rule:** Write valid JSON without `//` comments (`serde_json::from_str` in `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs`). Do not invent unsupported keys for table dimensions or table mass; record those figures in `general.description` and test doc comments. Use `"CAT40"` for `tooling.spindle_mount` (`crates/post/src/machine/tooling.rs::SPINDLE_MOUNTS` lists `"BT30"`, `"BT40"`, `"CAT40"`, `"TTS"`).
- **`assets/machines/okuma-genos-m560v.mch` (Okuma GENOS M560-V):**
  - Travels: X `-525..525` (1,050 mm), Y `-280..280` (560 mm), Z `-460..0` (460 mm, `safe_retract: 0.0`).
  - Speeds: rapid X/Y `40000`, Z `32000`; max cutting feed X/Y/Z `32000` mm/min.
  - Spindle: `50` to `15000` rpm, `22.0` kW, `rigid_tapping: true`.
  - Tooling: `number_of_tools: 32`, `spindle_mount: "CAT40"`, `max_tool_length: 300.0`, `max_tool_diameter: 90.0` (125 mm with empty adjacent pockets noted in description).
  - Coolants: `Flood` (`M08`), `Mist` (`M07`), `Through-spindle` (`M51`), `Air` (`M59`).
  - Description notes: table `1300 x 560 mm`, max load `900 kg`.
- **`assets/machines/okuma-genos-m660v.mch` (Okuma GENOS M660-V):**
  - Travels: X `-750..750` (1,500 mm), Y `-330..330` (660 mm), Z `-660..0` (660 mm, `safe_retract: 0.0`).
  - Speeds: rapid X/Y `40000`, Z `32000`; max cutting feed X/Y/Z `32000` mm/min.
  - Spindle: `50` to `15000` rpm, `22.0` kW, `rigid_tapping: true`.
  - Tooling: `number_of_tools: 32`, `spindle_mount: "CAT40"`, `max_tool_length: 400.0`, `max_tool_diameter: 90.0` (125 mm with empty adjacent pockets noted in description).
  - Coolants: `Flood` (`M08`), `Mist` (`M07`), `Through-spindle` (`M51`), `Air` (`M59`).
  - Description notes: table `1530 x 660 mm`, max load `1500 kg`, spindle nose to table `150-810 mm`.
- **Registration and tests:** Register both files in `MACHINES` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`), keep `crates/app/tests/machine_library.rs` green, and add `crates/app/tests/okuma_machines.rs` (`tormach_machines.rs` pattern) pinning all published specs.

Done means: both `.mch` files parse without comments, appear in `MACHINES`, pass `machine_library.rs`, and pass spec tests in `okuma_machines.rs`.

Part of #1959
